title.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual finished full-screen title key art for a Korean fantasy dungeon-restoration puzzle game, landscape 5:3 composition (1600x960 target). Reference 1 is composition inspiration ONLY: an enormous central stylized game logo integrated with a scenic fantasy background. Do NOT copy its words, farm, island or blue sky. Reference 2 is the exact existing protagonist design: small cute human dungeon mechanic wearing a teal hood, brass goggles on the hood, brown leather work apron, gloves, toolbelt. Preserve this character identity.
Create richly painted stylized 3D storybook game art. The setting is the interior of a ruined underground stone dungeon after a hero has left. Cool teal mist, ancient tall arches, golden torch light, scattered brass gears and broken spike-trap parts, a few cartoon skeleton bones. Foreground lower right: the mechanic carrying a brass trap part and looking into the ruined dungeon; lower left: a funny small disassembled skeleton soldier and toolbox, non-gory. Polished premium casual puzzle-game title art, sculpted shapes, readable silhouettes, warm hopeful mood.
Hero composition: an enormous centered two-line sculpted stone-and-brass Korean logo occupies x=20%-80%, y=17%-49% of the image, integrated into a crest with a small brass gear and repair wrench. Exact Korean title, verbatim, first line "용사가", second line "지나간 자리". Thick chunky legible beveled lettering, pale ivory stone faces, gold bevels, deep dark teal extrusion and shadow, strong separation from background. Correct Hangul spacing and all syllables. No English subtitle, no other text. Surrounding arches frame the logo.
Lower center x=34%-66%, y=65%-90% must be uncluttered dark stone floor reserved for real interactive menu buttons added by the game. Characters and detailed props stay outside that lower-center area. Full bleed artwork edge-to-edge. No UI panels, no card layouts, no borders, no slide layout, no fake buttons, no watermark.
references: User-provided Fantasy Farm title composition reference (not copied into the game).

comic.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: FOUR-PANEL STORY COMIC ATLAS for a Korean dungeon-restoration fantasy game. Generate one landscape image ideally 2048x1536 (4:3). Exactly four equally sized rectangular panels in an exact 2-by-2 grid with panel divisions at x=50%, y=50%. Each quadrant will be cropped and shown full-screen by the game. No gutters, no drawn borders, no text, no speech balloons, no letters, no logos. Keep every character and essential action safely inside its own quadrant. Reference image is the established protagonist: small cute human dungeon mechanic with teal hood, brass goggles resting on hood, brown leather apron, work gloves and tools. Preserve that identity in panels 2-4.
Style: polished expressive fantasy-game cartoon, beautiful inked silhouettes, soft cel shading and painterly textures, warm torchlight mixed with teal dungeon shadows, charming non-gory skeletons, strong storytelling, cinematic depth. Same dungeon and same art style in all panels. Each panel has a complete composition. Leave the bottom 20% of EACH panel visually quiet for captions that the game will render.
TOP LEFT, panel 1: a victorious armored fantasy hero with a red cape, seen mostly from behind, walks away up a staircase through a glowing far doorway. Foreground left contains destroyed brass spike traps, scattered gears, a broken cartoon skeleton guard and cracked flagstones. Hero exits the dungeon. Wide establishing scene, no mechanic yet.
TOP RIGHT, panel 2: the teal-hooded mechanic stands in the ruined dungeon, looks at a loose skull in one glove and a brass gear in the other with an amused determined expression. Around the mechanic: broken traps, separated cartoon skeleton limbs and empty guard posts. This is the aftermath and their job begins.
BOTTOM LEFT, panel 3: same mechanic kneels to fit a large brass component into a floor trap, tool in hand. Beside the mechanic a wooden assembly workbench holds skeleton bones and a friendly partly reassembled skeleton soldier waiting for its arm. Show repairing rather than combat. Warm sparks and hopeful motion.
BOTTOM RIGHT, panel 4: same mechanic safely stands beside an exit doorway and pulls a lever with an empty free hand. Behind the mechanic in the dungeon corridor, repaired brass spike traps are raised and friendly reassembled skeleton guards stand at their posts. Clear visual idea that repairs restore defense but block the passage, and the mechanic has kept a safe way out. Hopeful satisfied expression. No enemies or fight.
